# Independent final ControlStep review

CLEAN. Full final source, 27-probe/30-caller audit, proof delta, executed and portable guards, note, history, default preflight and controls read; no mathematical or provenance defect found.

Fixed external arity tuple is a bijection on all model codes: nine registers use eight Cantor pairs and the final register is the entire unconstrained tail.

Fixed Sigma1 graphs for projection, file packing, selectors, writes, effects, transition and step have literal output-first argument order; totality supplies Delta1 graphs. Arbitrary internal IOpen inputs are covered.

Writes preserve every unmatched register. Opcode 2 uses actual Foundation truncated subtraction; branch selection uses the old selected value. Opcode 3 has identical branch successors by the checked source data.

Live state is Cantor(control,file)+1. Absorbing 0 is guarded before subtraction. Invalid control/opcode 0 and actual halt opcode 4 both return 0 as separately explicit extensions; positive invalid state 1 is distinct from absorbing 0.

Run1-to-run2 changes are proof normalization, dependent induction generalization, Fin.cases/ifTrue and fixed-vector normalization. No function, graph or endpoint definition changed.

All 27 named probes and 30 callers use only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound; successful source/audit logs contain zero warnings.

Portable guard differs from original executed driver only in the frozen default final source hash. Original run2 supplied an explicit source override; its preserved older default is therefore not a proof provenance mismatch.

Exact 82-project current import closure and six external anchors, actual first Init/Omega, compiler, manifests, pins, source/object/evidence identities and the fresh object before/after audit were independently rehashed.

Maintained-default preparation is unbuilt with no commands/fresh objects. Four recorded controls reject optimized Python, nonempty output and actual first Init/Omega shadows; metadata discovery can query compiler version.

No represented run, binary simulation, internal L2/scheduler connection, runtime bound or unbounded spare invariant is asserted.

The successful run2 source/audit remain distinct from the unbuilt maintained preflight. All 1278 hash comparisons across 220 paths passed. No compiler or checker was invoked by this reviewer. Historical source-first review remains unchanged. Candidate mutable publication/map bytes are frozen in reviewer snapshots.
